method: Causal planar Kalman filter with SPP position and independent approximate Doppler velocity measurement updates
settings_selected_on: validation RMSE only, same eight position/process candidates as the existing filter baseline
source_methods: GraphGNSSLib pseudorange and Doppler motion information
Suzuki 2023 separation of velocity and position information
limitations: Method-inspired baseline, not GraphGNSSLib FGO or Suzuki TDCP/two-step algorithm reproduction.
Sequential position/velocity updates approximate their correlation as zero; RTKLIB velocity covariance is a model estimate, not empirical calibration.
Doppler is extracted only at the unchanged successful SPP population; no outage bridging or extra valid positions are credited.
Additional development experiment after inspecting baseline results, not a blind final benchmark. No alert/NLOS model retraining.
